by
  -- Since F is a functor from C to FintypeCat, F.obj X and F.obj Y are objects in FintypeCat,
  -- which means they are finite types. The natural isomorphism i : X ≅ Y induces a natural
  -- transformation F.map i : F.obj X ⟶ F.obj Y. By naturality of the isomorphism, the
  -- underlying functions of F.obj X and F.obj Y are in bijection, so their cardinalities are equal.
  let σ := F.map i
  have h : σ.app X = σ.app Y := by
    apply CategoryTheory.NatTrans.ext
    intro x
    apply FunctorToFintypeCat.naturality
    exact σ
    exact i
    exact x
  apply Finset.card_congr h
